task.title: Update the README and settle the Python CLI's role
task.description:
## Why
The README describes three ways to run the tool, all of them local or through a fork. Once the site exists, the two versions of the engine can drift apart.

## Steps
1. Add the hosted site to the README as the main way to get a report.
2. Document `web/`: local development, tests, fixtures and deploys.
3. Decide with the repo owner whether the Python engine stays the reference, with parity tests run on every change, or is frozen with only the benchmark crawler kept.
4. Update `docs/DESIGN.md` with the hosted design: storage, jobs and the rate limiter.

## Done when
- A new contributor can run the site locally from the README alone.
- The decision about the Python engine is written in the README.
